Still open

criticalNEW-02

Convert’s own cart write resets Cohort 2 on every page load

deployment trackCartAdd() → armCohort2Tracking()

What happens
Convert’s Shopify integration sends POST /cart/update.js with only a __event cart attribute on every page load and goal. The deployment counts any successful cart request with an eligible cart as a new add, so it resets cre276_session_ts and cre276_cart_added_ts to now and clears cre276_cohort2_shown. When that request lands before the 3s activation check, the returning visitor looks mid-session and gets nothing. When it lands after, the “already shown” cap is wiped.
Evidence
TC-21 (real add to cart, leave 2.5 min, return): no modal, both cookies stamped at the second of return. Request body captured: {"attributes":{"__event":"eyJjaWQiOiIxMDAzNDE1Ii…"}} (cid 1003415 is WinkBeds’ Convert account). TC-05 and TC-15 fail the same way.
Suggested fix
Arm only when not already armed, so attribute writes and other cart updates leave the state alone:
cartMeetsMattressCondition().then(function (eligible) {
    if (eligible) {
        if (!getCartAddedTs()) armCohort2Tracking(); // first eligible add only
    } else {
        disarmCohort2Tracking();                     // removing or swapping re-arms cleanly later
    }
});
highBUG-03

Cohort 2 modal opens at 17.7s instead of 5s after page load

activation setTimeout(checkAllConditionsAndActivate, 3000) + variation setTimeout(…, 5000)

What happens
The Variation’s 5s wait starts only after the activation’s own 3s wait and after Convert loads the experiment, so the offer lands 8s plus load time after the page starts.
Evidence
TC-04: 17.7s from navigation start on Chrome Desktop. Cohort 1 on the same run: 8.0s.
Suggested fix
Wait only for what is left of the 5s:
var remaining = Math.max(0, 5000 - performance.now());
setTimeout(async function () { /* re-verify, then showModal() */ }, remaining);
mediumBUG-07

The checkout cookie alone qualifies a visitor as Cohort 1

deployment getQualifyingCohort()

What happens
WIN257 required both the checkout cookie and Shopify’s checkoutSessionIdentifier in localStorage.__ui. WIN276 checks only the cookie, which is set by a mousedown on any a[href="/checkout"].
Evidence
TC-18: cookie seeded without __ui, modal at 7.8s.
Suggested fix
Add the WIN257 check:
function hasCheckoutSessionIdentifier() {
    try {
        var ui = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('__ui') || '{}');
        return !!(ui && ui[2] && ui[2][0] && ui[2][0].checkoutSessionIdentifier);
    } catch (e) { return false; }
}
if (checkoutSignal && hasCheckoutSessionIdentifier() && cartOk) return 1;

Scope and limits

  • Carry-over from WIN257, not re-tested: cart is emptied before the new variant is found, redirect fires even if the swap fails, “winkbed” substring match, no double-click guard.
